name: journey-builder
description: Builds the current-state journey map across all touchpoints, part of the Design Thinking Pack by 90n. Use this whenever the user says "run journey-builder", "map the customer journey", "build the current-state journey", "where does the experience break", or research exists and the team needs to see the whole experience end to end instead of their own touchpoint. Use it even for "what's it actually like to be our customer".
